# Get File Of Type

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves a file of the provided type from the given input..

## Syntax

~~~~text
getFileOfType(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>, type: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getFileOfType(input: ShortcutInput, type: "public.rtf")
~~~~
